question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_runner_orders r
    JOIN pizza_customer_orders co ON r.order_id = co.order_id
    WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL
),
pizza_with_toppings AS (
    SELECT od.order_id, od.pizza_id, pr.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders od
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON od.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
-- Parse recipe toppings into individual rows (using ', ' as separator)
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pwt.order_id,
        unnest(string_to_array(pwt.toppings, ', '))::BIGINT AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_with_toppings pwt
),
-- Parse exclusions into individual rows (using ',' as separator, only for orders with exclusions)
order_exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        unnest(string_to_array(co.exclusions, ','))::BIGINT AS excluded_top_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
       AND co.exclusions IS NOT NULL
       AND co.exclusions != ''
),
-- Get final toppings (recipe toppings minus exclusions)
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        rt.order_id,
        rt.topping_id
    FROM recipe_toppings rt
    LEFT JOIN order_exclusions oe ON rt.order_id = oe.order_id AND rt.topping_id = oe.excluded_top_id
    WHERE oe.excluded_top_id IS NULL
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM final_toppings ft
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON ft.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC, pt.topping_name
